title: Selskabsloven § 128 (bestyrelsesprotokol) and § 101 (generalforsamlingsprotokol)
source: Bekendtgørelse af lov om aktie- og anpartsselskaber (selskabsloven), LBK nr. 331 af 20/03/2025. Read on retsinformation.dk 2026-10-09; read again the same day against the four acts Retsinformation lists as amending the law since: lov nr. 710 af 20/06/2025 (§ 2), lov nr. 1648 af 16/12/2025 (§ 16), lov nr. 1765 af 29/12/2025 (§ 4) and lov nr. 729 af 01/09/2026 (§ 5). None changes § 101 or § 128.

rules.text: A board of more than one member keeps a protocol of its proceedings, signed by every member present.
A member present who disagrees with a decision may have their view entered in the protocol.
The general meeting elects a dirigent; a protocol of the proceedings is kept and signed by the dirigent.
The general meeting protocol, or a certified copy, is available to the shareholders within two weeks.
